vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the schedule and the 3-day wait.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates together, one PR per ecosystem a week. Majors get their own PRs (config:recommended).
Patch releases of JS dev tools get their own PR and merge themselves once CI passes. Nothing else does.
The Go toolchain line in go.mod moves only by hand: CI, the release builds and every box build follow it.

The box adds @workflow/world-postgres at a pinned release per `workflow` major (internal/mod/runtime/versions.go, WorkflowPostgresWorld), proven by the devkit e2e. Bump it there, by hand, after `make e2e`; never let it float in a fixture.
The devkit e2e app stays on workflow 4.x: it proves the box picks the 4.x Postgres world. A 5.x app is a new fixture, not an update.
The Prisma 6 pooler fixture exists to test Prisma 6 against PgBouncer; Prisma 7 is the other fixture.
Boxes run Postgres 18 (apt, minor updates only; PgBouncer and Postgres minimums are checked at start in internal/mod/postgres). Tests that embed Postgres must stay on the same major.
Better Auth packages move together: the auth engine and the vendored SDK must agree on one release.
Next.js and React move together across the starters, templates and fixtures.
